Get an object by its ID.



The object kind is inferred from the ID format (e.g., BLI-001 -> backlog_item).



Default get returns raw CAS/spec fields (no resolved_* embeds). Optional
--link-hydration

adds inline embeds; optional --fields keeps only those top-level keys (same
hybrid projection as list).

  Get a backlog item
  zqk.test get BLI-626
  Get with JSON output
  zqk.test get BLI-626 --format json
  Get with YAML output
  zqk.test get BLI-626 --format yaml
  Milestone completion report slice
  zqk.test get MIL-001 --view milestone-completion-report
  JSON with selected keys only (projection)
  zqk.test get PROMPT-001 --fields prompt_body --format json

Usage:
  zqk.test object get [flags]

Aliases:
  get, show, view

Flags:
      --fields stringArray       Top-level keys to include in output (repeat or comma-separated); same hybrid projection as list. Omit for full object after overlays. Put -h before --fields if you need help so '-h' is not parsed as a field name.
      --link-hydration string    Reference overlay: none/omit/raw (default) = no embeds; lazy = one hop; default = depth 2; eager = deeper.
      --resolved-sidecar-only    After hydrating, write sidecar and emit raw CAS object (no resolved_* in stdout)
      --view string              Optional view name to scope output fields (default: full object with reference-resolver overlay).
      --write-resolved-sidecar   Write hydration overlay to .zqk/resolved/… sidecar (CAS get stays raw when combined with --resolved-sidecar-only)

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
